decisionContract.randomness: none; no RNG or seed consumption
decisionContract.seatBinding: strict request seat and observation actorSeat agreement; no seat inference
decisionContract.informationSet: uses only actor-visible observation, legal action frontier, owner prompt, and public event receipt
prohibitedInformation: unexposed card identities inferred from generic labels
decisionContract.securityBoundary: trusted-code-only; policy and worker share a process; this is not a process or OS sandbox

promptContract.unsupportedPromptBehavior: abstain; never invent a prompt token
promptContract.prizeIdentityBehavior: require an exposed card printing; generic labels such as Prize 1 are not identities
promptContract.energyAttributionBehavior: Bellowing Thunder abstains if any Basic Energy is attached to a non-active Pokémon because ChooseEnergyPrompt choices do not identify the attached-to Pokémon

gameSpecificDecisionConstraints.basicEnergy: recognize Basic Energy by energy type across printings; do not treat Double Dragon Energy as Basic Energy
gameSpecificDecisionConstraints.bellowingThunder: only consider while Raging Bolt is Active, all attached Basic Energy is on that Active, gxUsed is explicitly false, and opponent Active has no unsuppressed visible Ability; otherwise abstain or do not select the attack
gameSpecificDecisionConstraints.hoOhRebirth: select exactly three distinct Basic Energy types when the matching owner prompt is present
gameSpecificDecisionConstraints.opponentEnergyDisruption: Wait and See Hammer may select only opponent-owned visible Energy choices; prefer Double Dragon Energy

sourceDeckAdmission.regionalCardPool: repository English card snapshot is explicitly not a complete Japanese Expanded card pool
sourceDeckAdmission.energyPrintingNote: source transcription uses MEE Basic Energy print codes; MEE is absent from bundled English set index; policy matches Basic Energy by type, not by claiming physical printing authenticity
